name: justbookify-india-backend
description: JustBookify India backend: Cloud Functions for Firebase (P10-01, D-159)

scripts.emulators: npm run build && cd .. && npx --yes firebase-tools@15.34.0 emulators:start --only functions,firestore --project demo-justbookify-india
scripts.emulators:test: npm run build && cd .. && npx --yes firebase-tools@15.34.0 emulators:exec --only functions,firestore --project demo-justbookify-india "npm --prefix functions run test:emulator"
